name: Mammotion
legalEntityNote: Mammotion is an operating brand used across several legal entities. Reviewed records name Shenzhen Mammotion Innovation Co., Limited for trademarks and newer equipment filings, Mammotion Technology Co., Limited in an early LUBA manufacturer record, MAMMOTION TECHNOLOGY LLC for U.S. sales and warranty, and Mammotion Technik GmbH for European and UK warranty operations.
headline: Mammotion ownership, LUBA and YUKA robots, manufacturing and global channels
description: A source-backed profile of Mammotion's multi-entity structure, Songling and AgileX history, LUBA and YUKA portfolio, model-level manufacturing evidence and regional sales entities.
metaDescription: Mammotion company profile: LUBA maker, Songling and AgileX history, legal entities, manufacturing evidence, channels and outdoor-robot strategy.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Mammotion, Songling Robot or AgileX Robotics. Trademark, regulatory and regional seller records are scoped to the named entity and product.
founded: January 2022 as Mammotion; the current company timeline traces its technology journey to 2016

ownership.summary: Mammotion is privately held, and the reviewed official sources do not disclose a current cap table or controlling parent. A Canadian YUKA trademark record documents a change from Songling Robot (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. to Shenzhen Mammotion Innovation Co., Ltd. effective 16 January 2024; a later MAMMOTION application names the Shenzhen entity directly. Those records establish a brand-history link, not current parent ownership. Mammotion's own 2022 launch material says the team inherited seven years of AgileX Robotics chassis and algorithm experience; that establishes technology lineage, not current AgileX ownership.

leadership.name: Jidong (Jayden) Wei
leadership.context: The 2022 LUBA announcement names Jidong Wei as founder; Mammotion's 2026 announcement uses Jayden Wei as CEO.

productPortfolio.name: LUBA robotic lawn mowers
productPortfolio.positioning: All-wheel-drive wire-free mowers for complex terrain, spanning large-lawn and compact product families.

productPortfolio.name: YUKA robotic lawn mowers
productPortfolio.positioning: Wire-free mowing platforms for smaller or moderate terrain, including models with optional sweeping and dumping workflows.

productPortfolio.name: SPINO robotic pool cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: A cordless pool-care extension launched in 2025 and expanded with a higher-end product in 2026.

productPortfolio.name: Maston commercial mower concept
productPortfolio.positioning: A professional autonomous-mowing concept introduced at CES 2026 in feasibility and technology validation, not a mature shipping fleet platform in the reviewed announcement.

manufacturingSupplyChain: A 2022 LUBA FCC test report names Hong Kong-based Mammotion Technology Co., Limited as both applicant and manufacturer for the tested AWD 5000, LUBA0001 and AWD 3000 models. The report states that its results apply only to the tested object.

Newer LUBA 2 equipment records and a 2024 Canadian trademark application name Shenzhen Mammotion Innovation Co., Limited at Mammotion's Shenzhen address. Applicant or trademark status does not by itself prove the factory for every current mower.

Mammotion's current public pages do not provide a single manufacturer list covering every LUBA, YUKA and SPINO SKU. Procurement teams should match the rating label, declaration, importer, invoice and warranty entity for the exact generation and market.
marketsChannels: Mammotion's current company page says it operates in more than 30 countries and regions, with local operating and service centers in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany and Australia.
The company names Walmart, Home Depot, OBI, Bauhaus and Lowe's among major retail partners, while also selling through regional Mammotion stores and dealers.

The legal counterparty changes by region and channel. MAMMOTION TECHNOLOGY LLC operates the U.S. store and warranty; Mammotion Technik GmbH provides the reviewed UK warranty. Dealer buyers should verify which entity invoices, imports and services the product.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Mammotion has moved from a wire-free AWD mower specialist into multiple lawn platforms, pool cleaning and a commercial concept, while building direct, retail and dealer reach across major markets. The breadth and pace of its navigation-led product launches make it a visible challenger to established outdoor-power brands. Its buyer-side constraint is organizational clarity: legal sellers, warranty providers and regulatory applicants differ by region and generation, and the public record does not justify simplifying Songling or AgileX history into current parent ownership or assigning one manufacturer to every SKU.
